visualCharacteristics: Bordered data table with a header row (bold column headings) and multi-paragraph cells; left-aligned text.
contentPattern: Key dates data table: header row then one row per assessment/period. First row is the header.
usage: Key dates and schedule tables: a header row of column headings followed by data rows with text, paragraphs and links.
reuseGuidance: Use for bordered tabular data whose first row is the header. Source rowspans are flattened; leave the repeated cell empty in following rows.
